notes: Landscape, straight-on, a single shelf of about forty books on the Crusades, the Templars and the Mongols against a white wall in flat daylight, no glare, slightly soft focus. French and English mixed. Titles as printed: the Cambridge atlas spine reads 'Warfare / The Middle Ages 768-1487'; the Charles Phillips spine carries the full 'An Illustrated History of the Crusades and the Crusader Knights'; the Setton volume is labelled by its title ('I' on the spine); the Grousset volume III is labelled with its volume line; the Runciman Penguin spine reads only 'A History of the Crusades'. Two books each appear twice under different authors (Jacques de Molay by Demurger and by Dailliez; Les Templiers by Gisserot and by Dailliez) and are labelled once. Left out: the last white spine at the far right (faded orange lettering, roughly 'L'Orient au temps des croisades', not readable with confidence) and the thin pale spine beside the Runciman with only a series number.
